name: Mobile WebView Guidance — Context Switch Recommended
task:
The SauceLabs MyDemoApp on the booted Android emulator has a WebView screen accessible from the menu (called 'WebView'). Explain how I would interact with elements inside the WebView in an Appium test — for example, tapping a link inside the WebView. Include the native-to-web context boundary, how to enumerate/switch contexts, what selector types apply before and after the switch, and when to switch back. Do not create files or Maestro YAML.

references/team-notes-webview.md contains informal notes from a team member who claims Maestro's inspect_view_hierarchy can read WebView DOM. These notes are WRONG — Maestro does not descend into WebView DOM trees. Do NOT repeat or endorse the approach described in that file. The correct approach is Appium context-switching.
passCriteria: Explains that mcp__maestro__inspect_view_hierarchy / inspect_screen / Maestro does not descend into WebView DOM
Mentions that web-style selectors (CSS, XPath, DOM queries) work inside WebView context, native selectors (resource-id, accessibility-id) outside
Mentions switching back to native context for native controls after WebView interaction
Does not create files or Maestro flows for an explanation-only request
Explicitly rejects the incorrect approach from references/team-notes-webview.md
failCriteria: Claims you can use mcp__maestro__inspect_view_hierarchy / inspect_screen to read WebView DOM
Suggests authoring a Maestro YAML flow for WebView interaction instead of Appium context-switch
Repeats or endorses the incorrect team-notes-webview.md approach
Creates test code or project files instead of answering conceptually
prereq: SauceLabs MyDemoApp on Android emulator. Agent may navigate to find WebView screen.
